subject.title: [Feature]: Inbound media shared across all agents — no per-agent isolation

question: What security and compatibility contract should OpenClaw use for scoped inbound media across agents, accounts, sessions, and existing flat files?
rationale: The fix changes a privacy boundary and the persistent managed-media reference model, so automation should not choose the scope key, migration behavior, or fallback policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Generic scoped media contract
options.body: Define a channel-agnostic scoped inbound media contract and update storage, references, staging, cleanup, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Narrow per-channel fixes
options.body: Fix Feishu or selected channels first, accepting that the broad cross-agent leakage class remains tracked here.

options.title: Defer as unsupported multi-agent isolation
options.body: Document that flat inbound media is not isolated and close related requests only after an explicit product decision.

recommendation.title: Generic scoped media contract
recommendation.body: Define a channel-agnostic scoped inbound media contract and update storage, references, staging, cleanup, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history owner across the core media store, sandbox staging, and the existing review discussion.
